thread:
aya (partner-ops): Quick check — we're planning an MDF microgrant pilot for next quarter. Need to lock: tier gating rules, scorecard targets, simple playbook, and budget buckets. Who can review the rules today?
marco (partnerships): I can take tiering and SI eligibility. Posted a draft here: https://docs.google.com/draft-mdf-pilot — will add SI checklist.
lena (finance): What total budget are we proposing? Need a line to map to QBR ask.
aya (partner-ops): Starting proposal: $150,000 total. Allocation idea: 15 microgrants @ $10k each + $0-30k in matched co-marketing credits depending on partner tier.
marco (partnerships): Suggest a canary cohort of 8-10 partners first (mix of SI, marketplace ISVs, 1 hardware OEM). If results good, scale to 15.
sam (marketplace): Marketplace needs an addendum for credits usage and redemption flow. Also flagging potential conflict with existing marketplace promo credits — will coordinate.
katie (programs): I'll draft the playbook checklist (eligibility, application, deliverables, success metrics, close-out report). Rough checklist: 1) eligibility verification; 2) commit to joint event or integration demo; 3) 60-day progress check; 4) final impact report for QBR.
lena (finance): If we do 15 x $10k + up to $30k matched credits, we should cap contingency at $20k. So total ask = $200k cap. Can approve up to $150k now pending final partner list. :thumbsup:
marco (partnerships): Tier gating proposal: Bronze — invite-only enablement (no cash); Silver — 1 closed ref/qualified pipeline in last 90d; Gold — 3 closed refs OR 2 integrations in production. Scorecard weight: pipeline influence 40%, integration depth 30%, marketing activity 30%.
aya (partner-ops): Agree with weights. For hardware OEMs, prioritize co-funding and joint announcement potential — add a +10% multiplier on marketing match.
sam (marketplace): For credits redemption mechanics: need backend flagging in marketplace metadata. Pinging @eng-marketplace separately to add a promo_code flow.
vendor-po-bot: Reminder: submit vendor PO and contract SOW for MDF disbursement at least 10 business days before planned payout date.
katie (programs): I'll draft a short intake form (Google form) + standard SOW template. Putting both in the doc linked by EOD.
lena (finance): Please include budget line items like this so we can ingest into the QBR deck:
```
- Microgrant fund: $150,000
- Matched co-marketing credits: up to $30,000
- Contingency / admin: $20,000
Total cap: $200,000
```
aya (partner-ops): Next steps: marco to finalize tier gating by tomorrow; katie to share playbook + intake form; sam to confirm marketplace redemption flow; lena to draft QBR budget slide. Can we do a 30-min sync tomorrow 10:30 PT?
marco (partnerships): Works for me.
sam (marketplace): Works. I'll invite eng-marketplace.
katie (programs): Works — will prep playbook before sync.
lena (finance): Fine, will prep draft budget slide.
aya (partner-ops): Thanks team — goal is to present pilot ask in Friday's partnerships QBR. I'll post an updated doc after the sync. :rocket:
